name: Shiori
description: Shiori is a lightweight bookmark manager you can host yourself. It saves pages as readable archives, supports tagging and search, and keeps a local copy so your bookmarks survive link rot. A quiet, focused tool for people who collect links on purpose.
highlights: Archives pages locally, immune to link rot
Tagging, search, and import from browsers
Single Go binary, no heavy dependencies
curatorNote: Shiori does one thing and does it without fanfare: it keeps your links alive. In an era of disappearing content, that is quietly valuable.
